meta.title: BubaPix — AI film and animation studio
meta.description: BubaPix is an AI-native film and animation studio. We turn ideas into characters, worlds and finished films for brands, artists and storytellers.

hero.lede: BubaPix is an AI-powered film and creative studio. We make films, animation, characters, original worlds and commercial content for brands.

process.title: From idea to film
process.intro: Five stages. The frames show the film gaining colour as it takes shape.

steps.name: It Starts with an Idea
steps.text: It can start with your idea, a product or business need, or an idea we develop together.

steps.name: We Shape the Story
steps.text: We write the script and build the story scene by scene, until the message is clear.

steps.name: We Build the World
steps.text: We design the characters, places and visual style, and approve them with you before production.

steps.name: We Create the Film
steps.text: We generate, direct and refine every shot until it meets a cinematic standard.

steps.name: Ready for the Screen
steps.text: We edit, add sound and music, grade the colour, and deliver in every format you need.

about.title: About BubaPix
about.p1: BubaPix is an independent studio where filmmaking craft meets generative tools. We treat AI as a camera, not a shortcut: every film still needs a story worth telling, a deliberate look, and someone who cares about each frame.
about.p2: We make films for brands, musicians and independent storytellers, from a single scene to a complete film.

final.title: Tell us the sentence. We'll build the world.
final.lede: Send a few lines about your idea, your audience and your timeline.
